dct_description_sm: THIS IS A GEOREFERENCED FILE. Map of Victoria and part of Esquimalt Districts, 1861 ... 4 inches to 1 mile. London. [Victoria and Esquimalt Districts, 1861]. Published by Day & Son, Lithrs. to the Queen, Gate Street Lincolns-Inn Fields, London. Reference key. Shows "Lands originally reserved from sale by the Hudson's Bay Company, government buildings, Indian or other extensive Reserves", some streams and wetlands, and generalized vegetation.
